events.factual_description: SHIBUYA CLUB QUATTRO presents Scaffold #3 on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, billing BODY/HEAD (Kim Gordon and Bill Nace) with Jim O'Rourke performing solo. Doors are at 18:00 and the performance starts at 19:00. The venue lists an advance standing price of ¥10,000, with a separate ¥600 drink charge, and general ticket sales beginning September 11, 2026 at 10:00. CLUB QUATTRO describes Scaffold as an event for experimental expression in the raw, fresh atmosphere of a live venue. Eplus-owned SPICE describes the series as developed through Jim O'Rourke, Eiko Ishibashi and CLUB QUATTRO, identifies BODY/HEAD as Gordon and experimental guitarist/improviser Bill Nace, notes the duo's guitar/voice, drone, noise and improvisational language, and describes O'Rourke's appearance as a return to solo performance after some time. The same Scaffold #3 bill is announced for UMEDA CLUB QUATTRO in Osaka on October 15, 2026.

en.why_it_matters: Scaffold #3 puts BODY/HEAD's tense two-guitar language—drone, noise, voice and improvisation—beside a comparatively uncommon Jim O'Rourke solo set, inside a series built to let experimental music breathe in a live-house setting rather than a formal concert frame. Gordon and Nace bring an American no-wave/improvisational lineage into direct contact with O'Rourke's long Japan-based practice. This is the kind of Tokyo bill worth actively making room for.
en.trip_verdict: If Tokyo overlaps October 13, build the evening around Shibuya Club Quattro. The same bill reaches Osaka on October 15, so I would keep the Tokyo date flexible within a broader Japan itinerary rather than reshape the trip solely to force this particular night.

es.why_it_matters: Scaffold #3 pone el lenguaje tenso de dos guitarras de BODY/HEAD —drone, ruido, voz e improvisación— junto a una aparición solista poco frecuente de Jim O'Rourke, dentro de una serie pensada para que la música experimental respire en el contexto directo de un live house y no en un marco de concierto formal. Gordon y Nace llevan una línea estadounidense de no wave e improvisación al encuentro de la práctica que O'Rourke ha desarrollado desde hace años en Japón. Es una de esas noches de Tokio a las que sí vale abrirles espacio.
es.trip_verdict: Si Tokio coincide con el 13 de octubre, armaría la noche alrededor de Shibuya Club Quattro. El mismo cartel llega a Osaka el 15, así que mantendría flexible la fecha dentro de un itinerario más amplio por Japón en vez de reconstruir el viaje sólo para forzar esta noche en particular.
